intro_en: You will learn to talk about paintings and sculpture in a gallery, and to describe artworks with the Mongolian participles -сан and -даг and with English past participle clauses like 'a painting created in 1950'.
intro_mn: Та галерейд зураг, баримлын тухай ярьж сурна. Мөн монгол хэлний -сан, -даг үйлт нэр болон англи хэлний 'a painting created in 1950' шиг өнгөрсөн цагийн үйлт нэртэй бүтцийг ашиглан уран бүтээлийг дүрслэх болно.

vocab.example_en: The artist painted on a large canvas.

vocab.example_mn: Энэ зурагт бийрийн тод зураас их байна.
vocab.example_en: This painting has many bold brushstrokes.
The colors of this painting are bright.
The museum's collection has many paintings.
The bronze sculpture is in front of the door.

review.notes: Vocab entry 3 was corrupted (Latin text and 'x' placeholders) and needed replacing. Number agreement in two examples was fixed, and the Mongolian intro terminology was improved. The sentences list is empty.

opus_fix.notes: The main error was the non-word 'сойл' for brushstroke. The Mongolian intro also had an inaccurate grammar term; the rest is correct and natural.

changes.why: 'сойл' is not a Mongolian word; a brushstroke is бийрийн зураас
Replaces the non-word 'сойл' with бийрийн зураас
'сул үйлт өгүүлбэр' is not a real grammar term; this now matches 'past participle clauses'
